summary: OKYO Pharma Ltd filed a Form 6-K on July 8, 2026, reporting positive feedback from an FDA Type D meeting. The FDA validated the regulatory and clinical path for urcosimod, supporting advancement into a global Phase 3 pivotal trial for neuropathic corneal pain (NCP). The NEPTUNE trial will enroll ~111 subjects in a 2:1 randomization of 0.05% urcosimod vs placebo. The company plans to seek Breakthrough Therapy Designation. No special-situation transaction (acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, etc.) is described; this is a routine regulatory update on clinical development. The filing does not contain any deal terms or special-situation event.
